[font=Courier New][color=#f4cccc][size=5][center]﻿[b]˗ˏˋ ♡ introduction ♡ ˎˊ˗[/b][/center][/size][/color][/font]
[size=2][font=Arial][color=#f4f4f4]hello everyone! this is kate aka katestardew. it's been a while since i made a mod because i again got busy in real life (finished uni, doing art commissions etc.). BUT! it is nice to finally release this mod i've been working on now that stardew valley 1.6 has been released. hope you enjoy this mod and look out for more updates + more mods in the future! ( ˊᵕˋ )[/color][/font]
[/size]
[font=Courier New][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b][center]˗ˏˋ ♡ about the mod ♡ ˎˊ˗[/center][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Arial][size=3]Soft Craftables is a craftables mod made to match my other mods, Casual Furniture Set and Oh So Cute Kitchen; basically, it goes along the cutesy pink theme i like (and will continue to make mods of). currently, this pack [u][color=#ead1dc]only holds 19 craftables[/color][/u][b] [/b][i]but as stated from here, including my other mods,[/i] [u]i [/u][u]will just find time to add more stuff when i can to update the set until i'm completely satisfied with the amount.[/u][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][size=3]this craftables mod is available for both Content Patcher (CP) and Alternative Textures (AT). [/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][size=3]for the CP version of the mod, [i]if you haven't seen the images provided for this mod, [/i][u]only the signs with a grass design is available.[/u][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][size=3]i recommend the AT version of the mod to be used if you want all variations of the signs to be available.[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b][font=Courier New][center]﻿[/center][center]˗ˏˋ ♡ instructions ♡ ˎˊ˗[/center][/font][/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[font=Arial][*][size=3]make sure you have SMAPI installed to use mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]if you would like to use the Content Patcher (CP) version of this mod, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher.[/url][/size]
[*][size=3]if you would like to use the Alternative Textures (AT) version of this set, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿put all the downloaded mods (based on your choice) in your Mods folder. by the way, you can use both versions of the craftables mod if you want![/size]
[*][size=3]turn on your game and have fun! [color=#00ff00]NOTE: [/color][u]if you use the AT version, make sure to buy the [color=#00ff00]Paint Bucket from Robin[/color]; equip it; get a specific craftables item (example: the chest, place it somewhere); then while equipping the Paint Bucket, click on the craftable and it will show a window which is a catalog of designs you can choose from![/u][/size]
[/font][/list][font=Courier New][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b][center]
